name: hunterFormsBS
summary: Flexible frequency-band splitter for music source separation. The BandSplitRoformer module supports BSRoformer, MelBandRoformer, and custom overlapping or non-overlapping band configurations. Fully typed, modular, and documented, including migration help, usage, and paper references. PyTorch; CUDA-accelerated.
author: Hunter Hogan, Phil Wang, Roman Solovyev (ZFTurbo)
